title: Our holiday in Italy
instructions: Kim ailesiyle İtalya tatilini anlatıyor. Şehirleri ve olanları takip et.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Last summer, my family spent two weeks in Italy.

script.speaker: s
script.text: First, we visited Rome. It was very hot and crowded, but the old buildings were amazing.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Then we took the train to Florence, where we stayed in a small hotel.

script.speaker: s
script.text: My favourite part was the food. I ate ice cream every day!

script.speaker: s
script.text: The only problem was that my brother lost his phone on the train.
